integrity: The proof certificate and five explicit finite separating models are provided. Their verification uses standard-library Python. Results are subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Exact count concerns unary word modalities of crisp Gödel S4, not weaker logics, all modal formulas, or minimum witness-model size. The all-model upper bound is justified by universally sound equations and a finite contextual reduction certificate. An algebraic reformulation may exist in older literature.
title: Exactly 35 unary modality classes in crisp Gödel \(\mathsf{GS4^c}\)
